description: Universal OpenAI Function Calling & MCP Tool Schema for `dynamic-chat-title` (Compatible with Dify, Coze, FastGPT, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, OpenWebUI Tools, LibreChat)

function.name: update_chat_title
function.description: Update the current conversation title ONLY when the discussion topic has undergone a sustained (>=3 turns), substantive shift across the conversation history, or when explicitly requested by the user. Never call for single-turn tangents or casual chitchat.

new_title.description: Concise, accurate new title matching the conversation language (6-16 Chinese characters or 3-8 English words). No filler like 'Discussion about...', no sensitive PII/keys.

reason.description: The specific trigger condition satisfied from the dynamic-chat-title specification.

mcp_tool.name: update_chat_title
mcp_tool.description: Update the current conversation title when a substantive, sustained topic shift occurs.

new_title.description: Concise new title (6-16 Chinese chars or 3-8 English words).
